title: Tools: Add a quiet option to asn2wrs
description:
Duplicate type and field names don't seem to be a big problem, so add a
"-q" option to asn2wrs which suppresses those warnings. Use it in the
"asn1" CMake target.

Tools: Add a quiet option to asn2wrs

Duplicate type and field names don't seem to be a big problem, so add a
"-q" option to asn2wrs which suppresses those warnings. Use it in the
"asn1" CMake target.
